documents.text: As the sun set over the bustling port of Chittagong, Bangladesh, the air was thick with the smell of saltwater, grease, and the distant hum of machinery. Amidst the chaos, a lone figure emerged from the shadows, his worn denim overalls and faded baseball cap a testament to his years of toil on the docks. This was Rizwan, a seasoned shipbreaker with a reputation for being one of the best in the business. Rizwan's eyes scanned the horizon, his gaze settling on the hulking mass of the MV Serenity, a retired cargo vessel that had seen better days. Its once-proud hull now rusted and battered, the ship was slated for demolition, its valuable components to be salvaged and recycled. Rizwan's team had been hired to do the job, and he was determined to get it done quickly and efficiently. As he made his way onto the ship, Rizwan's thoughts turned to the peculiar request from the ship's owner, a reclusive billionaire with a penchant for cutting-edge technology. The old man had insisted that a specialized power supply device be installed on the ship, one capable of handling dual voltage outputs. Rizwan had raised an eyebrow at the time, but the promise of a hefty bonus had convinced him to comply. Now, as he navigated the ship's cramped corridors, Rizwan caught glimpses of the device in question, its sleek metal casing emblazoned with the logo of a company called NovaTech. The Series power storage dual voltage power supply device, as it was called, seemed to be humming along smoothly, its LED lights blinking like a chorus of fireflies as it fed power to the ship's systems. Rizwan's team got to work, their torches and saws biting into the ship's steel plating as they began the painstaking process of disassembling the vessel. The air was filled with the acrid smell of burning metal and the sound of groaning steel, but Rizwan's mind was elsewhere. He couldn't shake the feeling that there was more to this job than met the eye, that the NovaTech device was somehow connected to the mysterious events that had been plaguing the port of late. As the night wore on, Rizwan's suspicions would only continue to grow, fueled by whispers of a rival shipbreaker's sudden and inexplicable misfortune.
